purpose: Teach: 図る/プライバシー/改造/浸透/中野/対照/許諾/質的

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究の発展を、本気で、絶対、図る、絶対、よう、絶対、頼むぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to push this research forward. Seriously. With everything you have.
lines.style: Calm, direct authority. Opens with the name like calling someone to attention. Measured pace. Each clause lands with quiet weight, no rushing. The kind of request that costs nothing to refuse but everything to ignore.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究対象者の、本気で、絶対、プライバシー、絶対、保護、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm ensuring strict protection of all research participants' privacy. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Formal but not stiff. Slight bow in the voice. Careful enunciation — he's showing he understands the weight of what was asked. Respectful pause before the gratitude, like he means it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実験装置の、本気で、絶対、改造、絶対、必要、絶対、見極めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Assess whether the experimental equipment needs modification. Don't guess.
lines.style: Clipped, precise. Practical rather than emotional. Eyes-forward tone — this is a concrete task. Light emphasis on 'assess' — he wants thinking, not just action. Finality without harshness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新理論、本気で、絶対、学界に、絶対、浸透、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'm working to integrate the new theoretical framework into the field. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Voice carries the weight of careful work already in progress. Not defensive — just laying out what's being done. Slight warmth on the final phrase, genuine gratitude, not ritual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 中野、本気で、絶対、教授、絶対、研究、絶対、参考にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Study Professor Nakano's research closely. Learn from what he's done.
lines.style: Mentor-like but not warm. Clinical precision. Slight upward inflection on 'closely' — emphasis on thoroughness. The tone of someone who knows what good work looks like and expects it to be matched.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。過去論文との、本気で、絶対、対照、絶対、分析、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm conducting a systematic comparison with the existing literature. Thank you for guiding me.
lines.style: Quiet competence. Slightly faster pace than the previous lines — he's showing he's already moving. Respectful but not obsequious. The gratitude is for the direction, not for being allowed to exist.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 被験者の、本気で、絶対、許諾、絶対、書、絶対、整えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure all participant consent forms are complete and properly documented.
lines.style: Administrative finality. No inflection wasted. This is non-negotiable. Clipped rhythm. The tone of someone checking boxes that matter, expecting them to stay checked.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、質的、絶対、向上、絶対、目指しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm committed to improving the quality of the final paper. Thank you for your mentorship.
lines.style: Steady close. Slight exhale before the final phrase — a moment of acknowledgment. Voice settles lower, like he's speaking more to himself about what he needs to do. Genuine, not performative.
